name: Closeout from Help Side to Contest at Game Speed
setup: Start in help-side stance on the far block, a partner with the ball at the wing.
cues: Full game speed now: if it gets sloppy, drop back to the slower version.
Sprint, then chop the feet short and get a high hand up toward the ball.
Sprint the first half, then chop short, quick steps on the floor.

faults.fix: Chop short, quick steps on the floor as you arrive, low and balanced.
Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.
